sources.what: Manufacturer: VZ e-HYBRID 272 PS, 4451/1839/1520 mm, 345 L; note that 4Drive 150 kW/195 kW with top-view camera = 420 L
ADAC facelift test: 2.0 TSI VZ Extreme DSG (from 11/24) 450 L / 1505 L roof-high; ADAC measurement 320/1185 L
ADAC: 1.5 e-HYBRID VZ DSG (07/24–10/25) 345 L / 1415 L
ADAC: 1.4 e-HYBRID VZ Tribe Edition (01/23–07/24) 345 L / 1415 L
Facelift: trunk unchanged at 450 L (FWD petrol), 4Drive 420 L
Manufacturer CH: 1.5 TSI mHEV 150 PS DSG
Manufacturer product catalog: heights by variant (about 1511–1537 mm)
Forum (unofficial): 450/420/345 L by drivetrain; VZ 4Drive folded 1475 L

generations.notes: Facelift 07/2024 not split: trunk volumes unchanged (FWD 450 L, 4Drive 420 L, e-HYBRID 345/1415 L per ADAC for both 1.4 and 1.5 e-HYBRID) and length differs by only about 1 mm (4450 pre-facelift vs. 4451 facelift). Height differs by variant: sources give about 1505–1537 mm, e.g. 1520 mm on the manufacturer's VZ e-HYBRID page and 1528 mm on another manufacturer page for the VZ. Sources give the wheelbase as 2679–2681 mm, and 2680 mm is used here. The 4Drive trunk is smaller (420 L) because of the changed rear-axle design and the top-view camera. The ADAC's own crate measurement is much lower (VZ 2.0 TSI: 320 L / 1185 L), but the values here are manufacturer VDA figures.

e-HYBRID 400–490 L depending on bench position
Manufacturer AT: 1.5 eTSI 642 L (max), e-HYBRID 490 L (max, bench forward)

generations.notes: Sliding rear bench: 540 L with the bench fully back, up to 642 L with it slid forward (Cupra AT lists 642 L for the 1.5 eTSI). The e-HYBRID trunk is smaller (ADAC: 450 L; UK reviews: 400–490 L depending on bench position; Cupra AT 490 L max). The battery removes the underfloor storage. Folded 1544 L (to the roof) comes from Parkers and a test of the 2.0 TSI VZ 4Drive. No official German folded figure was found. Wikipedia gives height as 1584 mm. Cupra's global dimensions page lists 508 L, which is inconsistent with all other sources.
